scope: Prerequisite follow-up prompted by the undefined low-rank approximation question.

lessonChanges.title: Singular value decomposition
lessonChanges.reason: Define low-rank approximation and the keep-largest rule. The follow-up clarity pass removes the extra optimal-error theorem and component-sum notation.

lessonChanges.title: Matrix
lessonChanges.reason: Teach matrix arithmetic and diagonal terminology before questions use them.

lessonChanges.title: Linear transformation
lessonChanges.reason: Define affine before it is used in answers and later network/Hessian questions.

lessonChanges.title: Probability
lessonChanges.reason: Independence was first explained in the following lesson, after its first question use.

lessonChanges.title: Bayes’ theorem
lessonChanges.reason: Define prior, likelihood and posterior explicitly.

lessonChanges.title: Monte Carlo estimation
lessonChanges.reason: The formula named standard error without explaining what it measures.

lessonChanges.title: Exponential and logarithm
lessonChanges.reason: State the logarithm domain before asking for an invalid input.

lessonChanges.title: Derivative
lessonChanges.reason: Explain local/global extrema before derivative and Hessian questions, rather than waiting for Optimization.

lessonChanges.title: Hessian and curvature
lessonChanges.reason: State the limit of the stationary-point test rather than assume advanced calculus.

lessonChanges.title: Lagrange multipliers
lessonChanges.reason: Explain the scope and limitations of the displayed method before assessment.

lessonChanges.title: Supervised learning
lessonChanges.reason: Introduce classification and generalization as concepts, not only as answer labels.

lessonChanges.title: Data leakage
lessonChanges.reason: Windowing is assessed long before its dedicated lesson.

lessonChanges.title: Decision trees
lessonChanges.reason: Define root and axis-aligned split before asking their roles.

lessonChanges.title: Class imbalance, precision and recall
lessonChanges.reason: Explicitly define the classification counts and accuracy used by the questions.

lessonChanges.title: Causal inference
lessonChanges.reason: Explain potential outcomes and why randomization helps before testing them.

lessonChanges.title: Epoch
lessonChanges.reason: Define ceiling and the partial-batch convention.

lessonChanges.title: Convolutional neural networks
lessonChanges.reason: Name and define receptive field before asking what it means.

lessonChanges.title: Graph neural networks
lessonChanges.reason: Define hop before questions about one- and two-hop propagation.

lessonChanges.title: Cosine similarity
lessonChanges.reason: Define unit vectors and unit normalization before cosine/contrastive questions.

lessonChanges.title: Contrastive learning
lessonChanges.reason: Define augmentation rather than introduce it only in a question.

lessonChanges.title: Principal component analysis
lessonChanges.reason: Explain projection operationally instead of assuming prior geometric vocabulary.

lessonChanges.title: Numerical precision
lessonChanges.reason: Define overflow before asking for its meaning.

lessonChanges.title: Vector-quantized autoencoder
lessonChanges.reason: Explain why the gradient estimator is needed and what it does, beyond naming its formula.

lessonChanges.title: Diffusion models
lessonChanges.reason: Explain the noise mixture symbols without requiring an additional probability distribution.

lessonChanges.title: Positional encoding
lessonChanges.reason: Remove an unnecessary forward reference to attention.

lessonChanges.title: Multi-head attention
lessonChanges.reason: Define projection and concatenation as used here; a learned projection is not necessarily an orthogonal PCA projection.

lessonChanges.title: Transformer
lessonChanges.reason: Define the architecture components and avoid implying the displayed ordering is universal.

lessonChanges.title: CPU
lessonChanges.reason: Define CPU core before asking its meaning.

lessonChanges.title: Memory capacity
lessonChanges.reason: Explain the memory categories required by the training-memory questions.

lessonChanges.title: Memory bandwidth
lessonChanges.reason: Define memory-bound before the terminology question.

lessonChanges.title: Assay quality control
lessonChanges.reason: Explain the distinct roles of reference materials, blanks and duplicates before assessing them.

lessonChanges.title: Geoscience data integration
lessonChanges.reason: Introduce coordinate reference systems before the map-overlay question.

lessonChanges.title: Spatial cross-validation
lessonChanges.reason: Define folds and the repeating evaluation process before using those labels.
